name: Etapa 21: Cebreros - Ávila
description_md:
Etapa 21: Cebreros - Ávila is a hard waymarked hiking route in Spain spanning 41.2 km. The route requires about 13 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule with 1215 m of ascent and 844 m of descent.

This national waymarked hiking network trail is signposted as GR 239. The itinerary passes Iglesia de San Pedro and the Church of San Pedro within 200 m. It also passes the Royal Monastery of Santa Ana, Ávila within 600 m.
